mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, s.unit_code, s.package_quantity, s.net_weight, s.weight_unit FROM sku s WHERE s.sku_id = #{skuId} AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.sku_id, ib.warehouse_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.lot_id, ib.on_hand_qty, ib.reserved_qty, l.manufactured_date, l.received_date, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date, l.lot_status FROM inventory_balance ib LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.sku_id = #{skuId} AND ib.is_deleted = 0 AND ib.on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY ib.inventory_balance_id

SELECT sc.sku_cost_id, sc.unit_cost FROM sku_cost sc WHERE sc.sku_id = #{skuId} AND sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sc.effective_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (sc.effective_to IS NULL OR sc.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY sc.effective_from DESC, sc.sku_cost_id DESC

SELECT ip.inventory_policy_id, ip.warehouse_id, ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id, ip.safety_stock_qty, ip.target_stock_qty, ip.daily_unit_holding_cost, ip.unit_disposal_cost FROM inventory_policy ip WHERE ip.sku_id = #{skuId} AND ip.is_deleted = 0 AND (ip.effective_from IS NULL OR ip.effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (ip.effective_to IS NULL OR ip.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY ip.inventory_policy_id

SELECT itcp.transfer_cost_policy_id, itcp.policy_code, itcp.cost_per_kg_km, itcp.effective_from, itcp.effective_to FROM inventory_transfer_cost_policy itcp WHERE itcp.active_yn = 'Y' AND itcp.is_deleted = 0 AND itcp.effective_from <= #{rangeEndDate} AND (itcp.effective_to IS NULL OR itcp.effective_to >= #{rangeStartDate}) ORDER BY itcp.effective_from, itcp.transfer_cost_policy_id
